comments.author: @IRWanderStudio
comments.text:
Hello,
I hope you are doing well.
I run a Bengali YouTube channel focused on travel, tourism, and interesting destinations around the world.
I would like to ask for your permission to use footage from your YouTube channel in my videos. I would use up to 5 minutes of footage from any individual video, depending on the topic.
I will add my own Bengali voice-over, narration, editing, and additional information about the destinations. I will also clearly credit your YouTube channel and provide links to the original videos in my descriptions.
I will not claim ownership of your original footage or content.
If you are comfortable with this arrangement, please let me know if you give me permission to use footage from your channel under these conditions. If you have any specific requirements for credit or attribution, I will be happy to follow them.
Thank you for your time and consideration.

replies.author: @IRWanderStudio
replies.text: ​@TraceTheGlobeThank you so much for your response. I completely understand and respect your decision. Wishing you and Trace The Globe lots of success in the future! 🙏🌍

replies.author: @TraceTheGlobe
replies.text:
Thank you so much for reaching out and for your interest in our content. We really appreciate your kind proposal.

Unfortunately, due to technical reasons and our current content licensing arrangements, we’re unable to give permission for our footage to be used on other channels.

We wish you the very best with your channel and future projects! 🙏
